18–19 November 2026

Upset the Rhythm: Grouper – Two-Day Residency

Wednesday 18 November 2026, 7.30pm
Grouper + Short Film Screening

Thursday 19 November 2026, 7.30pm
Grouper + Coby Sey

Please note these shows are SOLD OUT. A waiting list for returns is available on Dice:

- 18 November: https://link.dice.fm/Mcb92f87691c
- 19 November: https://link.dice.fm/y5d22ad9b9c9


GROUPER is a recording and performing project by Liz Harris. She lives and works on the Oregon Coast. On the first night, we’ll also present two short films by Takashi Makino and Tanja Engelberts, both recently scored by Liz. The second evening will open with a live set by Coby Sey.

https://grouper.bandcamp.com/
